about: Test fixture: a copy of calculus-bc/data/pages.json.

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Calculus BC practice by unit, topic or skill: every AB topic plus parametric, polar and series, with graph and table sets and typed answers graded by value.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a mathematical practice, with graph and table sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your Calculus BC spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Unit tests and practice exams
apps.desc: Timed Calculus BC unit tests and full practice exams in the real format: 29 + 13 multiple-choice, then 2 + 4 free-response, with and without a calculator.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the real four-part format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Calculus BC free-response practice in the recurring exam types, parametric, polar and series included, 9 points each, with rubrics and full-credit samples.
apps.card: Every recurring free-response type, with 9-point rubrics and sample answers.

apps.title: Justification trainer
apps.desc: Calculus BC justification practice: name the theorem or test, check its conditions, conclude, and compare an answer that earns the point with one that does not.
apps.lede: Write a justification, then check it against the rubric and two model answers: one that earns the point and one that loses it.
apps.card: Justify with the right theorem or test and its conditions, checked against a rubric.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Calculus BC cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with unit sheets, mixed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition Calculus BC flashcards built from the glossary, by unit and topic.

apps.title: Trainers
apps.desc: Calculus BC trainers: series and Taylor labs, parametric motion, polar curves, integration methods, Euler and logistic, plus the Calculus AB trainers.
apps.card: Trainers and drills, then the questions about what you did.

apps.title: Your dashboard
apps.desc: Your Calculus BC mastery by unit, topic and mathematical practice, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and mathematical practice.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every Calculus BC lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For Calculus BC teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and sharing pages to Google Classroom, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Series lab
tools.title: Series Lab
tools.desc: Choose and justify a convergence test, watch partial sums close in on the limit, and find an interval of convergence with both endpoints tested.
tools.blurb: Pick the test, check its conditions, test both endpoints.
tools.lede: Choose a test, justify it, and test both endpoints.

tools.name: Taylor lab
tools.title: Taylor Lab
tools.desc: Watch Taylor polynomials wrap a function as terms are added, move the center, and see the Lagrange and alternating series error bounds drawn as a band.
tools.blurb: Polynomials that wrap the function, with the error bound as a band.
tools.lede: Add terms and watch the polynomial wrap the function.

tools.name: Parametric motion
tools.title: Parametric Motion
tools.desc: A particle traced by x(t) and y(t): velocity and acceleration vectors, speed, distance by arc length, and the first and second derivatives of y with respect to x.
tools.blurb: A particle in the plane, its velocity and speed live.
tools.lede: Trace a particle and read its velocity, speed and distance.

tools.name: Polar lab
tools.title: Polar Lab
tools.desc: Polar curves drawn as theta sweeps, the area being swept shaded, area between two curves, dy/dx in polar form and what the sign of dr/dtheta says.
tools.blurb: Polar curves drawn as theta sweeps, area shaded as it builds.
tools.lede: Sweep theta and watch the curve and its area build.

tools.name: Integration methods
tools.title: Integration Methods
tools.desc: Integration by parts, tabular too, linear partial fractions and improper integrals as limits, then choosing the method for an integral, step by step.
tools.blurb: Parts, partial fractions and improper integrals, step by step.
tools.lede: Pick the method, then work it step by step.

tools.name: Euler and logistic
tools.title: Euler and Logistic
tools.desc: Euler steps on a slope field, too high or too low from concavity, and logistic growth with its carrying capacity and the point of fastest growth.
tools.blurb: Euler steps on a slope field; logistic growth and its limit.
tools.lede: Step along a slope field, then model logistic growth.
